reviews.comment: You're just a hater if you don't like him or his class. He is absolutely hilarious. I you ask him to cancel class for the sake of it I give it a 50% chance he does (works later in the semester).
The only grades are from in-class assignments and homework. TAKE HIM!

Super easy course! 70% HW (3 per week, graded by your partner) + 30% classwork (effort-based). Covers thermo, heat, fluids, etc., but explained simply. Great jokes and relaxed vibe. Tons of HW but all manageable. He may arrive late sometimes, but honestly, it doesn't affect how easy and enjoyable the class is. Easiest A you'll get (to replace 421)!

Ridiculous. Shows up 15-20 minutes late every single day. Learned about nothing in this class. Work is repetitive, it feels like every assignment is a repetition of the previous one. You never actually end up learning about HVAC systems.

This class is a gem for us seniors. All in-class assignments and homework, nothing else. You must go to every class! Other than that, it's just busy work. Dr. Pate understands a students workload and this class lightens it.

Dr. Pate utilizes a unique teaching style. Dr. Pate assigns a homework assignment to be due each day, and also assigns an in-class assignment each day. This class is a fair amount of work, but it is an easy A if you do the work. The material is interesting and the class was a very enjoyable experience overall. I definitely recommend Dr. Pate!

Dr. Pate assigns a lot of homeworks, but that is essentially all the class is. No exams, no quizzes, just homeworks and a project if you take the graduate section. He is very understanding with absences, and is a great prof. If you're interested in learning, you may be underwhelmed, but if you're looking for an A, take Dr. Pate.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Tough professor to rate. On one hand if you do all the assigned homework (one every class) you're very likely to get an A. No quizzes, exams, or projects is nice. But on the other hand I've never had a professor who's less interested in teaching. Shows up to every class fifteen minutes late and typically leaves about ten minutes after that.

Dr. Pate is awesome! Only HW, no tests or quizzes. If you're the type who needs to feel smart because that's your whole personality, take a different class. If you actually want to enjoy your last semester of college and don't make school your personality, take his class.

Don't listen to the other reviewers, they are weird for wanting to take a "higher intellectual being" kind of class. This man is a legend and a God-send for students. Makes the senior load a lot less stressful than it already is. No exams and quizzes, only HW.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Legend of a man, greatest class I have ever taken. could not have learned more. very punctual

Wont teach you literally anything, homework due every single class, always late, and when you ask a question will confuse you more than you were before you asked anything. At least there are no exams in this course, but honestly, he doesn't care so that it makes you not care either. So even just doing his long and pointless homework's is brutal.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Pate loves to assigned ridiculously long homework that are extremely repetitive and don't add value to the learning process. That being said, if you are willing to put in the 6 to 9 hours a week required for the homework, you will get an A. There are plenty more useful classes that don't burn you out on homework. Take a different elective.

Homeworks are basically collecting information than organize them in to a short report. Take times, but there's no difficulty to get an A. The purpose is to urge yourself to learn "general knowledge" of alternative energy on your own. If you are looking for a challenging course brings you advance knowledge of , this is not the place
